license_required.quote: no one except a licensee may: Represent or appear to represent that he is a licensee as defined in section 12201, subsection 6; or Issue a report as defined in section 12201, subsection 10‑A

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Board of Accountancy established under Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 1

moral_character_required.quote: "Good character" for the purposes of this section means lack of a history of dishonest or felonious acts.

degree_required.value: At least 150 semester hours of education, including a minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree
degree_required.quote: At least 150 semester hours of education, including a minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

accrediting_body.value: college or university acceptable to the board
accrediting_body.quote: a college or university acceptable to the board

required.quote: an applicant must demonstrate 2 years of experience under the direction of a certified public accountant licensed by any state or territory of the United States

duration.quote: an applicant must demonstrate 2 years of experience under the direction of a certified public accountant

kind.quote: The applicant's experience must include the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Board may use all or any part of the Uniform CPA Examination and the Advisory Grading Service of the AICPA or any other examination approved by the board.
exams.quote: The board may make the use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and the Advisory Grading Service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or any other examination approved by the board

required.quote: An applicant for renewal of a public accountant or certified public accountant license must show that requirements of continuing professional education have been fulfilled.

hours_per_period.quote: the number of hours of continuing professional education required for renewal, which may be no more than 40 hours and no less than 20 hours annually

period_years.quote: no more than 40 hours and no less than 20 hours annually

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to a person who obtains from a national association of state boards of accountancy verification that the individual's certified public accountancy qualifications are substantially equivalent to the certified public accountant licensure requirements of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, National Association of State Boards of Accountancy Uniform Accountancy Act.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license or certificate from another state and establish substantial equivalency with Maine requirements, or meet all current Maine requirements at time of application.
requirements.quote: The holder of a license or certificate issued by another state who establishes that holder's principal place of business in this State shall request the issuance of a license from the board prior to establishing such principal place of business.

regulatory_model.quote: No person holding a certificate may engage in the practice of public accountancy, unless that person also holds a valid license issued under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No person not licensed as a certified public accountant under this chapter may use or assume the title of "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device indicating that the person is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: no one except a licensee may: Issue a report as defined in section 12201, subsection 10‑A

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew authority to practice public accountancy in any other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew authority to engage in the practice of public accountancy in any other state for any cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with license issuance or renewal requirements, or to report required changes to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, on the part of an applicant or a licensee to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of that license or to report the changes to the board required by section 12252, subsection 6

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy or in filing (or failing to file) the licensee's own income tax returns.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy or in the filing or failure to file the licensee's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license issued under this chapter or a certificate or license issued under prior law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license issued under this chapter or a certificate or license issued under prior law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of public accountancy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of public accountancy.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of or practicing public accountancy" means the following combined activities by a person or firm: A. Representing to the public that the person or the firm is a licensee; and B. Performing or offering to perform, for a client or potential client, services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of or practicing public accountancy" means the following combined activities by a person or firm: A. Representing to the public that the person or the firm is a licensee; and B. Performing or offering to perform, for a client or potential client, services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills.

value: furnishing of advice on tax matters
methods_authorized.quote: Accounting or auditing skills include the issuance of reports, management advisory or consulting services, the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: Audit or other engagement under Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
Review or compilation of financial statements under Statement on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)
Examination of prospective financial information under Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
Engagement under auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB)
Examination, review or agreed upon procedures engagement under SSAE (other than prospective financial information)
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest service" means providing the following services: A. Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards, SAS; B. Any review of a financial statement or compilation of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Accounting and Review Services, SSARS; C. Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements, SSAE; D. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Any review of a financial statement or compilation of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Accounting and Review Services, SSARS

education_semester_hours_required.quote: At least 150 semester hours of education, including a minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: An examination applicant who has successfully completed at least 120 semester hours of education, including the basic courses in accounting and auditing required by paragraph B, and who expects to complete a minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree required in paragraph B is eligible to take the examination.

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: no notice or other submission may be required of any such individual

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with the provisions of this chapter and the board's rules
Cease offering or rendering professional services in the State if the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: must consent, as a condition of the grant of the practice privilege: A. To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; B. To comply with the provisions of this chapter and the board's rules; and C. To the stipulation that, in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering professional services in the State

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section may perform any of the services listed in section 12201, subsection 3‑A for any entity with its home office in the State as long as the individual does so through a firm that has obtained a license issued under section 12252

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to certified public accountants or public accountants who are licensed in a state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A certified public accountancy firm or public accountancy firm may include nonlicensee owners as long as: (1) All nonlicensee owners are individuals who actively participate in the certified public accountancy firm or public accountancy firm or an affiliated entity

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: As a condition to the granting or renewal of licenses to certified public accountancy firms, each applicant that provides an attest service other than compilations must successfully participate in an approved peer review program.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: The firm must undergo a peer review every 3 years for as long as it provides an attest service other than compilations.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm with a principal place of business outside the State is presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to the State's requirements and has all the privileges of licensees of the State and may provide professional services in the State without the requirement to obtain a license under this section or to otherwise notify or register with the board or pay any fee

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: show that each such office is under the charge of a person holding a valid license issued under section 12230 or 12231 or a corresponding provision of prior law or the laws of another state.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee or any partner, officer, shareholder or employee of a licensee may not voluntarily disclose information communicated to the licensee, or any partner, officer, shareholder or employee of the licensee, by the client relating to, and in connection with, services rendered to the client by the licensee in the practice of public accountancy. That information must be considered confidential

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director or employee of a licensee, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client in the practice of public accountancy, except the reports submitted by the licensee to the client and except for records that are part of the client's records, shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee, when performing for a client an attest service, may not receive a commission or a referral fee

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee or a licensee's firm may not: A. When involved in providing for a client an attest service: (1) Perform for a contingent fee any services for a client; or (2) Receive a contingency fee from a client; or B. Prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Subsections 1 to 11 do not apply to a person or firm holding a certificate, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in that country, whose activities in this State are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of or business entities of the country in which that person holds that entitlement

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence from the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order or conviction, respectively, without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm must hold a license issued under this section if it: (1) Has an office in this State performing any of the services described in section 12201, subsection 3‑A, paragraphs A to D

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to his client or former client upon request and reasonable notice: A. A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that the working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and B. Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client
